desc:
Custom PrestaShop module development adds the exact feature your shop is missing when no ready-made module fits. Ecom Swift LLC writes clean PHP that follows PrestaShop standards, tests it on a duplicate store and hands it over with notes.

## What is a custom PrestaShop module?

A PrestaShop module is a packaged piece of code that adds or changes behavior in the shop. It hooks into specific points, such as the product page, the cart or the order confirmation, and it can add its own settings page in the back office.

A custom module is one written for your shop alone. It is the right tool when the feature you need is unusual, when ready-made options do too much, or when they clash with the modules you already run.

## Why a workaround costs more than the right module

Without a proper module, shops patch the gap with edits inside theme files or core overrides. Those edits work until the next theme or PrestaShop update overwrites them, and then the feature quietly disappears. Another common workaround is installing a large third-party module for one small function, which adds weight and settings you never use.

A well-built module keeps your change in one place. It survives updates better, can be switched off cleanly and can be understood by the next developer who opens the code.

## How a custom module improves results

A custom module improves results by matching the shop to the way you actually sell. A delivery date picker lets customers choose when to receive an order. A custom product field collects engraving text or measurements. A special discount rule applies your own logic to carts. A supplier import keeps the catalog current, and a warehouse link passes orders to the people who pack them.

The benefit is a smoother process and fewer manual steps. Whether that grows revenue depends on the feature and your customers, so we describe what the module does, not what it will earn.

## What a good custom module includes

- A clearly written specification that states what the module does and does not do.
- Code that uses PrestaShop hooks rather than editing core files.
- A back office settings page for options, so staff do not need a developer.
- Support for several languages in front and back office text where needed.
- Safe handling of input, so forms and fields cannot be abused.
- Custom database tables only when the data truly needs them.
- Testing on a duplicate store before anything touches the live shop.
- A manual test checklist, and automated tests for the key flows in larger builds.
- Written documentation covering install, settings and behavior.
- Source code handed over to you, so you are not tied to us.

## How we build it

We start by writing down the feature in plain language and agree it with you. Then we build the module on a duplicate of your store, using hooks and the standard module structure. We test each part, then install it on your live shop at a time that suits you.

The Basic package delivers one module with one clear feature. Standard adds a back office settings page, up to two features, multilingual support, a test checklist and documentation. Premium covers a larger module with custom database tables, a link to one outside service, automated tests for the main flows and full handover of the source code.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Describe the problem you want solved, not only the solution you imagine.
- Check first whether an existing maintained module already does the job.
- Keep one module focused on one area of behavior.
- Keep the documentation with your store files.
- Re-test the module after every PrestaShop update.

**Avoid:**
- Asking for changes to core files, which updates will overwrite.
- Packing unrelated features into one module.
- Skipping the duplicate store test to save time.
- Storing sensitive data in a custom table without a reason.
- Assuming a module written for one PrestaShop release works on all others.

## Who this is for

This service suits shops with a business rule that off-the-shelf modules cannot express, such as a regional delivery calendar or an unusual wholesale price tier. It suits owners who pay each month for a heavy module and use a tenth of it. It also suits agencies that need a specific feature built for a client.

## How to get started

Send us a short description of the feature, who uses it and how it should behave on the product page, cart or order. Share a screenshot if you have an example. Give us developer access to a staging copy where possible, never your passwords. We reply with a written scope, build the module and deliver it with notes.
